title: Invitations
lead: Companies that found you in a shortlist. Your contacts open only to the one whose invitation you accept.

list.label: Invitation list
list.emptyText: Employers see you in shortlists by your category. When a company invites you, the invitation appears here and in the menu counter.

detail.revokedText: Since {{date}} the company no longer sees your name and contacts. The invitation stays in the list.
detail.urgentText: Reply by {{date}} Moscow time, otherwise the invitation closes.
detail.privacy: Until you accept, the company sees only your anonymous card.
detail.pickText: The list is on the left. Open any invitation to read the offer and reply.
detail.missingText: The link may be outdated. Choose an invitation from the list.

accept.title: Accept the invitation from {{company}}?
accept.text: {{company}} will see your full name, email, phone, Telegram, about text, roles and soft skills. A conversation with the company opens.

decline.title: Decline the invitation?
decline.text: {{company}} will see the refusal. Your contacts stay hidden and the invitation cannot be restored.

revoke.title: Revoke access to your contacts?
revoke.text: {{company}} will no longer see your name and contacts. The invitation stays in the list marked as access revoked.

toast.accept: Invitation accepted, the company sees your contacts
